targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(metric_count) AS "Orders Today" FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_order_inter WHERE metric_name = 'order_all_create' AND metric_value = 0 AND DATE(insert_time) = CURDATE();

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(pay_money) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "Avg Order Value" FROM luckyus_sales_order.t_order WHERE tenant = 'LKUS' AND status = 90 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE();

panels.title: Avg Order Value (需要 MySQL-salesorder 数据源)

targets.rawSql: SELECT metric_count AS "Active Stores" FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_shop_inter WHERE metric_name = 'shop_all_now_opening' ORDER BY insert_time DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(metric_count_comment AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS "Success Rate" FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_payment_inter WHERE metric_name = 'all_tenant_payment_success' ORDER BY insert_time DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(metric_count) AS "New Members" FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_crm_inter WHERE metric_name = 'crm_member_append' AND DATE(insert_time) = CURDATE();

SELECT insert_time AS time, SUM(metric_count) AS "Orders" FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_order_inter WHERE $__timeFilter(insert_time) AND metric_name = 'order_all_create' AND metric_value = 0 GROUP BY insert_time ORDER BY insert_time;

SELECT insert_time AS time, CASE metric_value WHEN 1 THEN 'In-Store/POS' WHEN 2 THEN 'Mobile App' WHEN 3 THEN 'Mini Program/Web' WHEN 8 THEN 'DoorDash' WHEN 9 THEN 'Grubhub' WHEN 10 THEN 'Uber Eats' END AS metric, SUM(metric_count) AS value FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_order_inter WHERE $__timeFilter(insert_time) AND metric_name = 'order_channel_create' GROUP BY insert_time, metric_value ORDER BY insert_time;

SELECT CASE metric_value WHEN 1 THEN 'In-Store/POS' WHEN 2 THEN 'Mobile App' WHEN 3 THEN 'Mini Program/Web' WHEN 8 THEN 'DoorDash' WHEN 9 THEN 'Grubhub' WHEN 10 THEN 'Uber Eats' END AS "Channel", SUM(metric_count) AS "Orders" FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_order_inter WHERE $__timeFilter(insert_time) AND metric_name = 'order_channel_create' GROUP BY metric_value ORDER BY SUM(metric_count) DESC;
SELECT SUM(metric_count) AS "Created" FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_order_inter WHERE metric_name = 'order_all_create' AND metric_value = 0 AND DATE(insert_time) = CURDATE();
SELECT SUM(metric_count) AS "Paid" FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_order_inter WHERE metric_name = 'order_all_paid' AND metric_value = 0 AND DATE(insert_time) = CURDATE();
SELECT SUM(metric_count) AS "Completed" FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_order_inter WHERE metric_name = 'order_all_finish' AND metric_value = 0 AND DATE(insert_time) = CURDATE();
SELECT SUM(metric_count) AS "Cancelled" FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_order_inter WHERE metric_name = 'order_all_cancel' AND metric_value = 0 AND DATE(insert_time) = CURDATE();

SELECT shop_name AS "Store", COUNT(*) AS "Orders" FROM luckyus_sales_order.t_order WHERE tenant = 'LKUS' AND status = 90 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() GROUP BY shop_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Top 10 Stores by Orders (需要 MySQL-salesorder 数据源)

targets.rawSql: SELECT shop_name AS "Store", COUNT(*) AS "Orders", ROUND(SUM(pay_money), 2) AS "Revenue" FROM luckyus_sales_order.t_order WHERE tenant = 'LKUS' AND status = 90 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() GROUP BY shop_name ORDER BY SUM(pay_money) DESC LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Store Performance Table (需要 MySQL-salesorder 数据源)

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS time, shop_name AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM luckyus_sales_order.t_order WHERE $__timeFilter(create_time) AND tenant = 'LKUS' AND status = 90 GROUP BY DATE(create_time), shop_name ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Store Orders Over Time (需要 MySQL-salesorder 数据源)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE metric_value WHEN 8 THEN 'DoorDash' WHEN 9 THEN 'Grubhub' WHEN 10 THEN 'Uber Eats' END AS "Platform", SUM(metric_count) AS "Orders" FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_order_inter WHERE $__timeFilter(insert_time) AND metric_name = 'order_channel_create' AND metric_value IN (8, 9, 10) GROUP BY metric_value ORDER BY SUM(metric_count) DESC;

SELECT insert_time AS time, CASE metric_value WHEN 8 THEN 'DoorDash' WHEN 9 THEN 'Grubhub' WHEN 10 THEN 'Uber Eats' END AS metric, SUM(metric_count) AS value FROM luckyus_iluckyhealth.t_collect_order_inter WHERE $__timeFilter(insert_time) AND metric_name = 'order_channel_create' AND metric_value IN (8, 9, 10) GROUP BY insert_time, metric_value ORDER BY insert_time;

SELECT create_time AS time, shop_name AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM luckyus_sales_order.t_order WHERE $__timeFilter(create_time) AND tenant = 'LKUS' AND status = 90 AND order_type IN ('DOORDASH', 'GRUBHUB', 'UBEREATS') GROUP BY create_time, shop_name ORDER BY time;
